summary: Optalis Management Solutions, a post-hospital rehabilitation and skilled nursing care provider, reported a data breach involving unauthorized network access that occurred between April 14-19, 2025. An investigation completed on June 10, 2026 determined that personal information was exfiltrated, including names, Social Security numbers, driver's license/state ID numbers, credit/debit card information, financial account details, medical treatment and diagnosis information, and health insurance policy numbers. Affected individuals were notified beginning June 29, 2026. Class action litigation is being investigated by attorneys.
